notes: Data only: chord symbols, keys, forms. No lyrics, no notation.
Keys are the chart keys in the iReal "Brazilian 220" community playlist (often the common jam/real-book key, not necessarily the original recording key).
composer_as_charted is the chart's composer field verbatim (iReal stores Last First).

form = section letters as marked in the chart (I = intro); form_with_bars gives bar counts per played section. form_confidence="check" flags charts with codas, tags or odd splits — verify against a recording before teaching from it.
Chord qualities use iReal-style symbols compatible with pillars/piano/music.js (maj7, m7, m7b5, 7, dim7, alterations).
